title: List view: after the two-row toolbar, userActions.refresh only governs the wide toolbar; tidy ListView's leftovers and decide what the key means in the default toolbar
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Split from PR #35918 (#35878, two-row list toolbar) by the seat, from its declaration review record 7058088095 (nit N1). Under epic #35547.

## What is left

The maintainer ruled 「刷新去掉」 for the default (compact) list toolbar, and #35918 does that. The view key `userActions.refresh` still has a live reader in the wide toolbar (`compactToolbar: false`), so the spec accept set and the liveness ledger don't move. Two leftovers stay in `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (read at `7b4adb10`):
- `displayOffered` still counts `toolbarFlags.showRefresh` (near :6835). When Refresh was the panel's only reason to show, the panel now opens with only its footer.
- The Refresh comment (near :7439–7443) still says it "sits in the panel's footer".

## To do

1. Drop the `showRefresh` term from `displayOffered`, fix the comment, and say in the key's describe that it governs only the wide toolbar's Refresh.
2. Decide, under ADR-0049 (enforce or remove), whether `userActions.refresh` should mean anything in the default toolbar. If it should not, that is a spec note on the key; if a retirement is proposed, it is its own card.

## Acceptance

- A view whose only display option was Refresh no longer opens an empty Display panel in the default toolbar.
- The key's describe matches what it does.

Blocked-by: #35918.
Reader: area:ux (ui/packages/plugin-list), `domain:ui`.
